name: mihomo-rules-ui
description: Web UI for mihomo (Clash.Meta) routing rules: manage custom rule-provider sets and edit/delete built-in rules in place, with backup, YAML validation, reload verification and automatic rollback.

scripts.lint: node -e "const{execSync}=require('child_process');const fs=require('fs');const walk=d=>fs.readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true}).flatMap(e=>e.isDirectory()?walk(d+'/'+e.name):[d+'/'+e.name]).filter(f=>f.endsWith('.js'));for(const f of walk('.'))execSync('node --check '+f,{stdio:'inherit'});console.log('syntax ok')"
